name: Black Whale 1
description: Vaisseau semi-submersible colossal en forme de baleine noire, comptant 41 ponts et pouvant accueillir 200 000 passagers.

name: Position aboard unknown
description: The character is canonically aboard the Black Whale, but the manga has not established a tier or room for this event.

name: Zodiac HQ
description: Administrative location used by the Hunter Association's Zodiacs before departure; it is not a room aboard the Black Whale.

name: Tier 1
description: Separate cruise ship carried on top of the Black Whale. It houses Kakin royalty, V5 politicians, industry dignitaries, the three major mafia bosses, and Beyond Netero's holding cell.

name: Banquet Hall
description: Ceremony and reception hall between the King's and Princes' living quarters, used for the departure ceremony and scheduled Sunday banquets. It holds the inaugural banquet on the afternoon of the first day, with Nasubi on his throne and the princes leaving at staggered intervals.

name: King's Living Quarters
description: King Nasubi's residence, separated from the Princes' living quarters by the Banquet Hall. Chapter 382 shows its double-height salon in detail: a coffered barrel vault carried by square piers, geometric inlaid flooring, a wall crowded with framed art around one monumental battle scene, an ornamented mantel and sideboards, upholstered seating, several low tables, drinks service, sculpture and clipped plants.

name: Queens' Living Quarters
description: Residential block assigned to the eight queens of Kakin. The deck plan places it on Tier 1, but no scene has yet been shown inside it: the queens who matter to the contest are quartered with their sons, Oito in room 1014 and Sevanti in room 1013.

name: Queen's Room 01
description: One of the eight rooms of the queens' block. The plan gives the block eight queens; it does not say which room belongs to which queen, so any occupant here is placed by rank, not by a panel.

name: Queen's Room 02
description: One of the eight rooms of the queens' block. The plan gives the block eight queens; it does not say which room belongs to which queen, so any occupant here is placed by rank, not by a panel.

name: Soldiers' Living Quarters
description: Barracks for the Royal Army detachment posted to Tier 1. Roughly 2,000 guards and soldiers sail with the ship and 70% of them are stationed on Tiers 1 and 2; Mizaistom later moves 800 of them down to the lower tiers.

name: Princes' Burial Chamber
description: Funerary hall where the princes killed during the voyage are laid out. The hall is round, with fourteen coffins set radially about a central spire — one per prince, prepared before anyone has died. Momoze is the first to occupy hers: chapter 371 puts the king at her open coffin, refusing to mourn a daughter he calls part of the foundations of Kakin. Halkenburg's burial is held there later, and Chrollo works the mourners with Love Dial 6700 under cover of the procession.

name: Lifeboat Deck
description: Launch bays and emergency access on the outer edge of Tier 1. Chapter 383 shows the guarded EMERGENCY door and keypad, the broad launch hall with columns, stairs and wall loudspeakers, and the spherical pods on their cradles. Inside a pod, the ribbed circular shell surrounds a bare segmented deck, a central post with a broad base, a round exterior hatch, its low instrument console and a separate side cabinet; no passenger seats are visible. Kacho and Fugetsu reach open water from here.

name: VVIP Living Quarters
description: Tier 1 VVIP residential neighborhoods, where the leaders of mafia families linked to royalty live in particular.

name: VIP Casino
description: Casino reserved for Tier 1 passengers. The real Hisoka plays SQ-X there on the eleventh day of the trip.

name: Supreme Court
description: Highest jurisdiction on the ship, managed by Supreme Magistrate Cleapatro. Chapter 376 shows it in session on the morning of the third day: bench, stand and public benches, the two princes' camps pleading Camilla's attack on Benjamin. It is the one place aboard where the contest is fought with counsel rather than Nen, and its rulings bind princes — confinement to the VIP zone, court supervisors on every outing, a search of every residence on Tier 1.

name: VIP Jail
description: Supreme Court high security VVIP incarceration area. Camilla and Benjamin are both confined here from the morning of the third day, by Cleapatro's ruling, until Musse is caught: their own protection details stay with them, and a supervisor answering to the court accompanies either prince whenever they leave the zone.

name: Beyond Netero's Holding Cell
description: High security cell holding Beyond Netero. Three Zodiacs hold the guard side of the bars around the clock: Saiyu, Saccho Kobayakawa and Kanzai.

name: Royal Residential Sector
description: Vast central artery serving the 14 luxurious suites of the princes of Kakin. Canon calls each suite a zone, numbered after the prince it houses, and posts one of Kurapika's Hunters to each: zone 14 is his own, room 1014. Four more bodyguards are found exsanguinated in this corridor on the first afternoon.

name: Room 1001 (Benjamin)
description: Living quarters assigned to 1st Prince Benjamin and his household at the start of the voyage.

name: Room 1002 (Camilla)
description: Living quarters assigned to 2nd Prince Camilla and her household at the start of the voyage.

name: Room 1003 (Zhang Lei)
description: Living quarters of 3rd Prince Zhang Lei, where he receives allies and representatives of the Xi-Yu family.

name: Room 1004 (Tserriednich)
description: Living quarters of 4th Prince Tserriednich, where Theta trains him in Nen.

name: Room 1005 (Tubeppa)
description: Living quarters assigned to 5th Prince Tubeppa and her household.

name: Room 1006 (Tyson)
description: Living quarters assigned to 6th Prince Tyson and her household.

name: Room 1007 (Luzurus)
description: Living quarters assigned to 7th Prince Luzurus and his household; the Cha-R family is affiliated with him but its shipboard office is on Tier 5.

name: Room 1008 (Salé-salé)
description: Living quarters assigned to 8th Prince Salé-salé and his household, shown hosting his entourage and parties.

name: Room 1009 (Halkenburg)
description: Living quarters assigned to 9th Prince Halkenburg and his household.

name: Room 1010 (Kacho)
description: Living quarters assigned to 10th Prince Kacho and associated with the return door of Fugetsu's Guardian Spirit Beast ability, Magical Worm.

name: Room 1011 (Fugetsu)
description: Living quarters assigned to 11th Prince Fugetsu. Her Guardian Spirit Beast creates the spatial passage called Magical Worm.

name: Room 1012 (Momoze)
description: Crime scene of the 12th Princess Momoze, strangled here in chapter 368. From chapter 373 onward the door is crossed with KEEP OUT tape and held by armed soldiers: access is refused outright, and the refusal covers the telephone inside — a guard who asks only to place a call is turned away. The room is one of the sealed points of Tier 1 rather than a place anyone still passes through.

name: Room 1013 (Marayam)
description: Living quarters of 13th Prince Marayam. His Guardian Spirit Beast isolates him in a Nen-created duplicate while the physical room remains on the ship.

name: Room 1014 (Woble)
description: Living quarters of 14th Prince Woble, guarded by Queen Oito, Kurapika, and their reduced security detail; Kurapika's Nen classes take place here.

name: Tier 2
description: Home to the aristocracy, celebrities, financial elite and supportive Hunters.

name: Heil-Ly Secret Hideout
description: Morena's secret base, reached through five entrances whose rooms are connected by Nen teleportation, which is why it long read as a space of its own between Tiers 2 and 3. Hinrigh's transmitter, planted beyond the room 3101 trap, places it on Tier 2.

name: Ministry of Justice
description: Five-story structure constituting the ship's most neutral jurisdiction.

name: VIP Witness Protection Area
description: Lavishly furnished area described by Kaiser as the safest place on the ship; Melody, Fugetsu, and Kacho's Guardian Spirit Beast are held there for questioning and protection.

name: Screening Room
description: Amphitheatre-shaped hall on Tier 2, drawn in the chapter 359 cutaway: raked rows of cinema seating facing a projection wall, used to brief the tier's passengers rather than to entertain them.

name: Tier 2 Bulkhead
description: Colossal watertight bulkhead separating Tier 2 from Tier 3. Can only be unlocked from Tier 2.

name: Tier 3
description: Highest tier open to general passengers, with first-class and standard cabins, medical and political wards, and several Zodiac operations.

name: Political Ward
description: Central section bringing together law enforcement agencies.

name: Central Police Station
description: Four-story building under the authority of Mizaistom Nana, incorporating dormitories for officers.

name: Central Courthouse
description: Managed by Botobai Gigante, handling civil crimes with the assistance of popular juries.

name: Kakin Royal Army Conference Room
description: Conference room used for ship-security briefings and headed during the voyage by Mizaistom, from his first briefing to the royal troops at the departure to the emergency meeting where he moves 800 of the 2,000 soldiers down to Tiers 3-5.

name: Central Hospital
description: State-of-the-art medical facility on the ship.

name: Room 3101 (Heil-Ly Trap)
description: Ordinary Tier 3 passenger room used as a teleportation trap leading intruders to the Heil-Ly secret hideout; it is not the hideout itself.

name: First-Class Residential Block
description: Upper passenger cabins on Tier 3, the best accommodation available outside the royal tiers. The Hunter Association contingent works from here: at the departure seven of them sit a logistics meeting in the compartment — the Zodiacs Pyon, Gel, Cluck and Ginta, the doctors Sanbica Norton and Tokarine, and one unnamed Hunter.

name: Standard Residential Block
description: Ordinary Tier 3 cabins, and the hunting ground of Morena's Contagion carriers: Luini alone kills twenty people here before teleporting out, and the resulting panic is what pushes Mizaistom to redeploy the Royal Army. Room 302, where Morena infects the twenty-three Heil-Ly in chapter 378, is one of these cabins; the panel gives its door plate but nothing that would place it on the deck plan, so it has no entry of its own.

name: Cineplex
description: Tier 3 cinema. Bonolenov, wearing Hisoka's face on Chrollo's orders, sits through a film here waiting for the Heil-Ly to notice him and move him somewhere more interesting.

name: Observation Deck
description: Public viewing deck on Tier 3, the highest open area general passengers can reach.

name: Heil-Ly Family Office
description: The Heil-Ly family's registered Tier 3 premises. The published plan establishes the office and entrance, but the manga does not reveal a complete interior layout. Chapter 378 separately shows Morena behind a door marked 302: only the numbered doorway, a dark open gathering space and the semicircle formed by her twenty-three followers are visible, so no unshown furniture should be inferred.

name: Tier 4
description: Large general-passenger tier with one medical clinic, controlled in practice by the Xi-Yu family, which helps maintain public order.

name: Xi-Yu Family Office
description: Shipboard office of the Xi-Yu family, located in the forward portion of Tier 4 within the Black Whale's teeth.

name: Tier 5
description: Lowest class, precarious dormitories. Starting point for the Phantom Troupe's hunt for Hisoka.

name: Tier 5 Medical Clinic
description: Only Tier 5 clinic, under-equipped and without dedicated doctors.

name: Central Passage Tier 4–5
description: Central passage connecting Tiers 4 and 5. Chrollo, Shizuku and Bonolenov progress there on the fourth day of the journey.

name: Central Dining Hall
description: Tier 5's crowded central refectory: six rows of long, low dining boards with passengers seated directly on the deck, a low central platform used by the Phantom Troupe, a continuous staffed service counter, fixed stools, six framed menu boards and exposed trusses, gantries, ducts and cable runs under the high ceiling. The Buor toll is outside in the access passage, not inside the hall.

name: Recycling & Sewage Facilities
description: Sewage processing facility for the ship's passengers, located between Tiers 4 and 5. Its precise internal layout and any connection to Heil-Ly routes are unconfirmed.

name: Central Police Dorm Room
description: Dorm room at the Central Police Station offered by Mizaistom to Illumi and Kalluto so they can remain on Tier 3 under surveillance.

name: Tier 5 Standard Cabins
description: Standard cabins in the popular Tier 5 area. Machi is located there alone after the Brigade's dispersal.

name: Cha-R Family Office
description: Cha-R office beside the propeller, protected by a smart steel door and two cameras; it contains an office, bedroom, and surveillance monitor room. Chapter 380 shows the reception room the family calls its headquarters: the clan emblem framed on the wall between two doors, a desk, facing sofas around a low table, ceiling cameras of its own, and the monitor room next door from which the family records and watches the places that matter to it on Tier 5. The back door of the warehouse is kept locked, so the footage of the theft shows the intruder leaving by the way he came in; the cameras cover the entrance and nothing else.

name: Ei-I Family Office
description: Office of the third of the three mafia families aboard, alongside the Xi-Yu and Cha-R ones. The chapter 380 cutaway is the only thing that places it: a compartment on the fourth deck, above the central passage, with Luini inside it at ten on the morning of the fourth day. Nothing has been drawn of its interior.

name: Hangar Entrance
description: Way into the Tier 5 hangar, near the warehouse the Cha-R keep. The chapter 380 cutaway posts Feitan here at ten in the morning of the fourth day; the hangar guard walked away from this door is what let the warehouse theft happen two chapters earlier.

name: Warehouse
description: Cha-R-controlled warehouse storing regular and black-market goods, watched by four guards before Luini's attack and by a camera installed at the entrance.

name: Area 37564
description: Numbered Tier 5 assembly area with a 28 × 14 m footprint in the tour reconstruction. Volumes 34–36 establish its name and function but do not show an identifiable interior; no furniture, pillars, ducts, ceiling treatment or occupants can therefore be placed from those volumes.
